package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ModuleRelationsHandler handles module-section relations.
type ModuleRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator         *validator.Validate
	AddSectionUC      moduleuc.AddModuleSection
	ReplaceSectionsUC moduleuc.ReplaceModuleSections
	DeleteSectionUC   moduleuc.DeleteModuleSection
}

// AddSection handles POST /module-relations/add-section/{moduleID}.
func (h ModuleRelationsHandler) AddSection(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	var req struct {
		SectionID string `json:"section_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order     int    `json:"order" validate:"min=-32768,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddSectionUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleuc.AddModuleSectionInput{
		ModuleID:  moduleID,
		SectionID: req.SectionID,
		Order:     req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeModuleRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// ReplaceSections handles PUT /module-relations/replace-sections/{moduleID}.
func (h ModuleRelationsHandler) ReplaceSections(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceSectionsUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeModuleRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// DeleteSection handles DELETE /module-relations/delete-section/{moduleID}/{sectionID}.
func (h ModuleRelationsHandler) DeleteSection(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	if err := h.DeleteSectionUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleID, sectionID); err != nil {
		writeModuleRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func writeModuleRelationError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrValidation {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
